aiSearch.errors.providerBalanceLow: Site AI balance is below CNY {threshold}, so the service is paused. Try again later, or use your own model or basic search.
aiSearch.errors.providerBalanceUnavailab: Site AI balance cannot be verified right now, so the service is paused. Try again later, or use your own model or basic search.
aiSearch.errors.providerBalanceReason.MI: Site AI server key is not configured, so its balance cannot be checked. The site owner must set the Worker UPSTREAM_API_KEY; this is separate from your personal model key.
aiSearch.errors.providerBalanceReason.AU: Site AI server key is invalid or expired, so the balance check was rejected. The site owner must check the Worker UPSTREAM_API_KEY; this is separate from your personal model key.
aiSearch.errors.providerBalanceReason.FO: DeepSeek rejected the balance check (HTTP 403). Site AI is paused; the site owner must check account permissions or request access restrictions.
aiSearch.errors.providerBalanceReason.RA: DeepSeek rate-limited the balance check. Site AI is temporarily paused; click Refresh status later to try again.
aiSearch.errors.providerBalanceReason.UP: DeepSeek’s balance endpoint is temporarily unavailable. Site AI is paused; click Refresh status later to try again.
aiSearch.errors.providerBalanceReason.TI: Site AI balance check timed out. Site AI is temporarily paused; click Refresh status later to try again.
aiSearch.errors.providerBalanceReason.NE: Site AI service could not connect to DeepSeek’s balance endpoint. Site AI is paused; click Refresh status later to try again.
aiSearch.errors.providerBalanceReason.IN: DeepSeek’s balance response could not be validated. Site AI is paused; the site owner must check the API response.
aiSearch.errors.providerBalanceReason.CN: The account did not return a verifiable CNY balance, so the CNY {threshold} safety threshold cannot be checked. Site AI is paused; the site owner must check the account currency.
aiSearch.errors.providerBalanceReason.AC: DeepSeek reports that the site’s account is unavailable. Site AI is paused; the site owner must check the account status.
aiSearch.errors.providerBalanceReason.AB: Site AI balance check was interrupted. Site AI is temporarily paused; click Refresh status to check again.

aiSearch.requestDiagnostics.title: Request diagnostics
aiSearch.requestDiagnostics.hints.noResp: The browser did not provide a readable response, so this error alone cannot identify the cause. Possible causes include CORS, network, DNS, TLS, proxies, or provider access policies. Check the URL and the browser’s Network and Console panels.
aiSearch.requestDiagnostics.hints.timeou: The request timed out or was interrupted at this stage. Check elapsed time, round, and network logs. During a search, the overall timeout also includes other model calls and retrieval.
aiSearch.requestDiagnostics.hints.auth: HTTP 401: check that the API key is correct, valid, and issued for this endpoint.
aiSearch.requestDiagnostics.hints.forbid: HTTP 403 means access was denied. Check the account, model permissions, and provider policy; the status alone does not identify the exact restriction.
aiSearch.requestDiagnostics.hints.rateLi: HTTP 429: read the provider’s reason and check request frequency, account limits, or balance. This is separate from this site’s daily free allowance.
aiSearch.requestDiagnostics.hints.servic: HTTP 5xx: a response was received, but the service or gateway failed. Check the provider message and retry manually later.
aiSearch.requestDiagnostics.hints.reject: Use the error code, message, and parameter to check the API URL, model name, and tool or JSON output support.
aiSearch.requestDiagnostics.hints.respon: The response could not be read in the expected format. Check API compatibility and whether a gateway returned HTML or other unexpected content.
aiSearch.errors.serviceDenied: The service denied access. Check the site or asset service’s permission settings.
aiSearch.requestDiagnostics.hints.servic: This service returned HTTP 429, which may reflect site allowances, budgets, or request frequency. Use the error code and message to identify the limit.
This service denied access. Check site or asset service permissions; this does not establish that your model API key is invalid.
aiSearch.errors.bodyInterrupted: The service responded, but reading the response body was interrupted. Try again later.
aiSearch.requestDiagnostics.hints.bodyIn: The displayed HTTP status and headers were received, but reading the response body was interrupted. Check the network log and service status.
